convert_olmo2_weights_to_hf: run the OLMo2 weight converter CLI to transform EleutherAI OLMo2 checkpoint weights into HuggingFace Transformers format
convert_olmo2_checkpoint: convert an OLMo2 model checkpoint from input directory to HuggingFace format with tokenizer and fixed eos token id
convert_olmo2_without_tokenizer: convert an OLMo2 model checkpoint to HuggingFace format without including the tokenizer conversion step
convert_olmo2_custom_tokenizer: convert an OLMo2 model checkpoint to HuggingFace format using a custom tokenizer json file path
convert_olmo2_compute_intermediate_size: compute the intermediate FFN dimension for an OLMo2 model given a hidden dimension and ffn dim multiplier
